name: Create content for slide-based presentations
description: Users requested the creation of detailed content, outlines, or complete files for slide-based presentations on diverse subjects such as academic topics, business strategies, safety training, and general knowledge. While some requests specified generating PowerPoint files or code, most focused on writing the textual material, bullet points, and speaker notes for specific slides or entire decks.
